title: Garden Paused
description: A surreal dark scene shows a hooded figure labeled 'WANDER' pushing a burning shopping cart filled with skulls, a white horse, and a 'WELLCORE' sign. In the foreground lies a glowing 'REAL 108' sign and a small boat on dark water. A large masked figure in red with multiple eyes and floating phones stands amid smoke and flowers, overlooked by a giant weeping multi-eyed female face with aurora-like hair. A chain-link fence and a 'GARDEN PAUSED' structure appear in the background.
